answer_quote: Yes. The gross specimen shown is an excised mass/tissue on a surgical towel that demonstrates features of carcinomatosis — a hemorrhagic, variegated surface studded with pale‑to‑white tumor nodules and areas of dark blood clot, consistent with serosal/peritoneal implants from an endometrial primary.
note: 可见离体肉眼标本及多发结节、出血样区域，但无法仅凭图像确认浆膜/腹膜种植或子宫内膜原发，故整体解释记null。
